+def split_minor(minor: int, parts: int) -> list[int]:
+    """Equal parts, rounded down; the first parts get one more minor unit until the sum is right."""
+    share, rest = divmod(minor, parts)
+    return [share + 1] * rest + [share] * (parts - rest)
